html.title: Gina shafin HTML na farko
html.body:
HTML yana bayyana tsarin shafi.

kanun labari ne,

sakin layi ne, mahaɗi ne. Alamomin buɗewa da rufewa suna kewaye da abun ciki. href yana nuna inda mahaɗin zai kai. Fara da kanun labari da gajeren sakin layi. Rubutun mahaɗi ya bayyana inda zai kai. Shafi ya kasance mai fahimta ba tare da launi ko hoto ba.
html.practice: Rubuta HTML game da kanka: h1, p game da abubuwan da kake so, da a zuwa shafi mai amfani. Bayyana aikin href.
html.statement: HTML yana bayyana tsarin shafin yanar gizo.

css.title: Yi wa shafi ado da CSS
css.body:
CSS yana sarrafa launi, tazara da shimfiɗa. Selector yana zaɓar sashe; declarations a cikin {} suna saita properties. A h1 { color: green; }, h1 selector ne, color kuwa property ne.
Yi rubutu mai sauƙin karantawa. Faɗin 900px na iya wuce allo na waya. max-width: 100% yana taimaka wa abun ciki ya dace da allo.
css.practice: Rubuta CSS don launin kanun labari da padding na sakin layi. Bayyana dalilin dacewa da ƙaramin allo.
css.statement: CSS yana kawar da buƙatar tsarin HTML.
css.code:
h1 { color: green; }
p { padding: 16px; max-width: 100%; }

javascript.title: Ƙara hulɗa da JavaScript
javascript.body:
JavaScript yana amsa ayyuka. querySelector yana gano sashe; addEventListener yana gudanar da function idan event ya faru. textContent yana canza rubutu ba tare da ɗaukarsa HTML ba.
Yi amfani da button na gaske don keyboard ya yi aiki. Shafi ya kasance mai amfani kafin script ya zo.
javascript.practice: Rubuta button da click listener wanda zai canza sakin layi zuwa saƙon maraba. Bayyana event ɗin da ke fara canjin.
javascript.statement: Click event listener na iya amsa idan an kunna button.

data.title: Yi tambaya mai amfani da bayanai
data.body: Bayanai su ne abubuwan da aka rubuta. Fara da tambaya, tsara abubuwan da aka gani a rows da fields a columns. Abin da ya ɓace ba sifili ba ne. Duba ma’auni da maimaitawa. Average shi ne jimilla raba da yawan ƙimomi.
data.practice: Tallace-tallace: 10, 20, 30. Lissafa average, rubuta ma’auni, da tambayar da lambobin ba za su amsa ba.

cyber.title: Kare asusu
cyber.body: Yi kalmar sirri daban ga kowane sabis, ka adana da password manager. Multi-factor authentication yana ƙara bincike. Saƙon bazata mai neman sirri ko code na iya zama phishing. Buɗe sabis kai tsaye don tabbatarwa.
cyber.practice: Bayyana yadda za ka binciki saƙon shiga na bazata. Rubuta hanyoyi biyu na kare asusun gwaji; kada ka saka sirri na gaske.
cyber.statement: Aika code na shiga ga duk mai cewa shi ma’aikacin taimako ne yana da aminci.

ai.title: Fahimci hasashen model
ai.body: Model na machine learning yana koyon tsari daga misalai. Bayanan horo suna shafar hasashe. Yana iya yin kuskure, musamman da sabbin misalai daban. Gwada da misalai dabam, ka duba kurakurai ma.
ai.practice: Ga model mai gane ’ya’yan itace, bayyana misalan horo da na gwaji daban. Faɗi inda zai iya kuskure.

design.title: Zana don buƙatar mai amfani
design.body: Ƙwarewar mai amfani tana farawa da mutum da buri. Bayyana matsala kafin zana allo. Lakabi mai kyau yana sauƙaƙa zaɓi. Gwada zane mai sauƙi kafin gini. Lura da inda mutum ya makale.
design.practice: Zana matakai uku don adana darasi. Rubuta burin mai amfani da tambayar gwaji.
design.statement: Gwada zane na iya gano matsaloli kafin gina app.

marketing.title: Tsara saƙo mai amfani
marketing.body: Talla tana haɗa abu mai amfani da masu buƙatarsa. Bayyana masu sauraro, matsalar da kake warwarewa da aikin da za su yi. Auna sakamako kamar tambayoyin saye, ba kallo kaɗai ba. Kada ka yi da’awa marar hujja.
marketing.practice: Rubuta saƙon sabis na unguwa. Faɗi masu sauraro, amfani, aiki ɗaya da ma’aunin nasara.
marketing.statement: Ƙarin kallo yana nufin ƙarin kwastomomi koyaushe.

business.title: Gwada ra’ayin kasuwanci
business.body: Ra’ayin kasuwanci yana buƙatar matsalar kwastoma da tayin da zai yi aiki. Yi magana da kwastomomi kafin kashe kuɗi da yawa. Revenue kuɗin shiga ne; profit yana la’akari da tsada. Ƙaramin gwaji yana nuna darajar tayin.
business.practice: Ana sayar da abu 100, tsadar samarwa 70. Lissafa bambanci kafin sauran tsada, sannan bayyana ƙaramin gwajin kwastoma.
business.statement: Dole a la’akari da tsada wajen ƙiyasta riba.

writing.title: Rubuta don mai karatu
writing.body: Rubutu mai kyau yana da buri da masu karatu. Fara da muhimmin batu, yi kalmomi bayyanannu, ka ba da mataki na gaba. Gyara jimlar da ke haɗa ra’ayoyi da yawa. Duba ko mai karatu yana da bayanan yin aiki.
writing.practice: Rubuta jimloli huɗu don gayyatar aboki zuwa karatu. Saka buri, lokaci, wuri da aikin gaba.
writing.statement: Sanin masu karatu yana taimaka wajen zaɓar bayanai.

project.title: Raba aiki zuwa ƙananan ayyuka
project.body: Aikin project yana da sakamako, ayyuka da iyaka. Raba aiki, sanya masu alhaki da gano dependencies. Wani aiki na iya jiran wani ya ƙare. Duba ci gaba, ka daidaita shiri.
project.practice: Tsara taron karatu da ayyuka huɗu, masu alhaki da dependency ɗaya. Bayyana nasarar da ake so.
project.statement: Dukkan ayyukan project suna iya farawa lokaci guda koyaushe.

teaching.title: Taimaka wa mutum ya koya
teaching.body: Darasi yana buƙatar buri bayyananne, misali, gwaji da ra’ayin gyara. Nuna fasaha kaɗai ba koyarwa cikakke ba ne. Bari ɗalibi ya gwada kuma ya bayyana tunaninsa. Yi amfani da amsarsa don darasi na gaba.
teaching.practice: Tsara darasin minti goma kan fasaha da ka sani. Rubuta buri, aikin gwaji da tambayar fahimta.
teaching.statement: Gwaji da ra’ayin gyara suna taimaka wa malami ya duba fahimta.

web-semantic.title: Yi amfani da HTML mai ma’ana
web-semantic.body:
header na gabatarwa ne, main na babban abun ciki, footer na bayanin ƙarshe.

Tsari bayyananne yana ba kowane sashi aikinsa. Karanta misalin daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka gano abin shiga, muhimman filaye da sakamako. Nuna bayanin da babu shi maimakon ƙirƙirarsa. Alamomi masu daidaito suna sauƙaƙa dubawa da sake amfani da aikin.
web-semantic.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Yi amfani da HTML mai ma’ana”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-semantic.statement: header na gabatarwa ne, main na babban abun ciki, footer na bayanin ƙarshe.

web-layout.title: Gina tsari mai dacewa da allo
web-layout.body:
Grid auto-fit yana ƙirƙirar ginshiƙai masu shiga; minmax yana hana kati yin ƙanƙanta sosai.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.
web-layout.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Gina tsari mai dacewa da allo”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-layout.statement: Zaɓin da ya fi kyau a gani shi ne mafi dacewa ga kowane buri.
web-layout.code: .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }

web-forms.title: Karɓi bayanai da fom
web-forms.body:
label yana bayyana input; type=email yana duba tsari, required yana hana babu bayanai.

Gwaji mai amfani yana bayyana abin shiga da sakamakon da ake tsammani kafin dubawa. Gwada misalin, sannan gwada babu bayanai ko abin da ba a zata ba. Rubuta abin da ya faru ka yi ƙaramin gyara. Sake gwadawa bayan gyara don tabbatar da warware matsalar.
web-forms.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Karɓi bayanai da fom”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-forms.statement: label yana bayyana input; type=email yana duba tsari, required yana hana babu bayanai.

web-dom.title: Haɗa abubuwa da DOM
web-dom.body:
querySelector yana gano abu; addEventListener yana haɗa aiki da function; textContent yana canza rubutu.

Wasu matakai suna dogara da na baya. Bi kibiyoyin misalin ka bayyana abin da zai fara da dalilinsa. Shirya abin da za a yi idan mataki ya kasa. Duba kowane sauyi kafin ci gaba; kaiwa ƙarshe kaɗai ba ya nuna cewa duk aikin ya yi nasara.
web-dom.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Haɗa abubuwa da DOM”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-dom.statement: Matakin dogaro yana iya farawa kafin na farko koyaushe.

web-access.title: Sauƙaƙa shafi ga kowa
web-access.body:
Button na gaske yana aiki da keyboard. Rubutu yana buƙatar bambancin launi da bayyanannen suna.

Shawara mai amfani tana danganta da abin da aka gani kuma ta nuna mataki na gaba. Duba misalin don hujjar nasara da wahala. Raba abin da ka gani da abin da ka zato. Inganta abu guda ka duba tasirinsa; ƙaramin samfur ba ya wakiltar kowa.
web-access.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Sauƙaƙa shafi ga kowa”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-access.statement: Button na gaske yana aiki da keyboard. Rubutu yana buƙatar bambancin launi da bayyanannen suna.

web-debug.title: Gano kuskure ka gwada aiki
web-debug.body:
Gwada adadi na yau da kullum da sifili: 5 × 3 = 15, 5 × 0 = 0.

Gwaji mai amfani yana bayyana abin shiga da sakamakon da ake tsammani kafin dubawa. Gwada misalin, sannan gwada babu bayanai ko abin da ba a zata ba. Rubuta abin da ya faru ka yi ƙaramin gyara. Sake gwadawa bayan gyara don tabbatar da warware matsalar.
web-debug.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Gano kuskure ka gwada aiki”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-debug.statement: Gwajin nasara guda yana tabbatar da aiki a kowane yanayi.

web-project.title: Gina shafinka na kai
web-project.body:
Haɗa HTML mai ma’ana, CSS mai sassauci da aikin keyboard a shafinka.

Haɗa ƙwarewar da ka koya a ƙaramin aiki. Yi amfani da misalin a matsayin tsari, saita buri mai amfani ka ƙirƙiri abin da za ka nuna. Gwada shi da burinka, bayyana iyaka guda da gyara guda. Riƙe rubutunka da hujja don wani ɗalibi ya fahimci shawararka.
web-project.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Gina shafinka na kai”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
web-project.statement: Haɗa HTML mai ma’ana, CSS mai sassauci da aikin keyboard a shafinka.

data-clean.title: Tsaftace ƙaramin bayanai
data-clean.body:
Maimaita ID na iya nuna kwafi. Babu ƙima yana nufin ba a sani ba, ba sifili ba.

Tsari bayyananne yana ba kowane sashi aikinsa. Karanta misalin daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka gano abin shiga, muhimman filaye da sakamako. Nuna bayanin da babu shi maimakon ƙirƙirarsa. Alamomi masu daidaito suna sauƙaƙa dubawa da sake amfani da aikin.
data-clean.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Tsaftace ƙaramin bayanai”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-clean.statement: Maimaita ID na iya nuna kwafi. Babu ƙima yana nufin ba a sani ba, ba sifili ba.

data-measures.title: Zaɓi ma’aunin taƙaitawa
data-measures.body:
Matsakaici yana shafar manyan ƙimomi; median ita ce ƙimar tsakiya bayan jerawa.

Lissafi yana buƙatar bayanan shiga, aikin lissafi da ma’auni. Yi misalin da hannu kafin amfani da kayan aiki. Duba abin da ake rabawa da shi, bayanan da babu su da ko sakamakon ya yi ma’ana. Daidaiton lissafi yana buƙatar mahalli kafin yanke shawara.
data-measures.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Zaɓi ma’aunin taƙaitawa”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-measures.statement: Ma’auni da abin rabawa ba su da muhimmanci a lissafi.

data-sheets.title: Yi lissafi da takardar lissafi
data-sheets.body:
SUM yana tara ƙimomi, AVERAGE yana lissafin matsakaici, COUNT yana ƙidaya sel masu lambobi.

Lissafi yana buƙatar bayanan shiga, aikin lissafi da ma’auni. Yi misalin da hannu kafin amfani da kayan aiki. Duba abin da ake rabawa da shi, bayanan da babu su da ko sakamakon ya yi ma’ana. Daidaiton lissafi yana buƙatar mahalli kafin yanke shawara.
data-sheets.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Yi lissafi da takardar lissafi”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-sheets.statement: SUM yana tara ƙimomi, AVERAGE yana lissafin matsakaici, COUNT yana ƙidaya sel masu lambobi.

data-filter.title: Jera ka tace bayanai
data-filter.body:
Tacewa tana riƙe layuka masu dacewa; jerawa tana sauya tsari ba ƙimomi ba.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.
data-filter.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Jera ka tace bayanai”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-filter.statement: Zaɓin da ya fi kyau a gani shi ne mafi dacewa ga kowane buri.

data-charts.title: Zaɓi jadawalin da bai yaudara ba
data-charts.body:
Jadawalin sanduna yana kwatanta rukuni. Bayyana ma’auni ka fara axis daga sifili.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.
data-charts.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Zaɓi jadawalin da bai yaudara ba”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-charts.statement: Jadawalin sanduna yana kwatanta rukuni. Bayyana ma’auni ka fara axis daga sifili.
data-charts.code:
A: ███ 30
B: ██ 20
C: █ 10
// axis starts at 0; same unit

data-sql.title: Tara bayanai da SQL
data-sql.body:
GROUP BY yana haɗa rukuni; SUM yana lissafin jimlar kowane rukuni.

Tsari bayyananne yana ba kowane sashi aikinsa. Karanta misalin daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka gano abin shiga, muhimman filaye da sakamako. Nuna bayanin da babu shi maimakon ƙirƙirarsa. Alamomi masu daidaito suna sauƙaƙa dubawa da sake amfani da aikin.
data-sql.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Tara bayanai da SQL”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-sql.statement: Bayanin da babu shi dole ya zama sifili koyaushe.

data-privacy.title: Kare bayanan mutum
data-privacy.body:
Maye sunaye da ID yana rage fallasa, amma sauran bayanai na iya gano mutum.

Yi amfani da bayanan ƙirƙira a wannan aiki. Karɓi abin da ake buƙata kawai, cire abin da zai gano mutum kuma rage masu iya gani. Misalin yana nuna bayanan da za a cire ko izinin da za a duba. Kada ka rubuta kalmar sirri ta gaskiya, bayanan tuntuɓa ko takardun sirri.
data-privacy.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Kare bayanan mutum”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-privacy.statement: Maye sunaye da ID yana rage fallasa, amma sauran bayanai na iya gano mutum.

data-evidence.title: Bayyana sakamako da iyakoki
data-evidence.body:
Bayyana yawan samfur da rashin tabbas. Alaƙa ba ta tabbatar da sanadi ba.

Shawara mai amfani tana danganta da abin da aka gani kuma ta nuna mataki na gaba. Duba misalin don hujjar nasara da wahala. Raba abin da ka gani da abin da ka zato. Inganta abu guda ka duba tasirinsa; ƙaramin samfur ba ya wakiltar kowa.
data-evidence.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Bayyana sakamako da iyakoki”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-evidence.statement: Ƙaramin samfur yana tabbatar da buƙatar kowane mutum.

data-project.title: Ƙirƙiri rahoton bayanai
data-project.body:
Amsa tambaya guda da tsaftataccen data, jadawali mai alama da shawara mai iyaka.

Haɗa ƙwarewar da ka koya a ƙaramin aiki. Yi amfani da misalin a matsayin tsari, saita buri mai amfani ka ƙirƙiri abin da za ka nuna. Gwada shi da burinka, bayyana iyaka guda da gyara guda. Riƙe rubutunka da hujja don wani ɗalibi ya fahimci shawararka.
data-project.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Ƙirƙiri rahoton bayanai”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
data-project.statement: Amsa tambaya guda da tsaftataccen data, jadawali mai alama da shawara mai iyaka.

cyber-phishing.title: Gane hanyar yaudara
cyber-phishing.body:
Duba hostname: example.test.evil.test na evil.test ne, ba example.test ba.

Haɗari yana haɗa yiwuwar faruwar abu da illarsa. Kwatanta yiwuwa da tasiri a misalin sannan zaɓi matakin kariya. Fara da manyan haɗari ka bayyana mai ɗaukar mataki. Jerin dubawa yana rage kuskure amma ba ya kawar da duk barazana.
cyber-phishing.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Gane hanyar yaudara”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
cyber-phishing.statement: Duba hostname: example.test.evil.test na evil.test ne, ba example.test ba.

cyber-privacy.title: Riƙe bayanan sirri
cyber-privacy.body:
Kalmar sirri da lambar shiga sirri ne; yi amfani da misalan ƙirƙira a rahoto.

Yi amfani da bayanan ƙirƙira a wannan aiki. Karɓi abin da ake buƙata kawai, cire abin da zai gano mutum kuma rage masu iya gani. Misalin yana nuna bayanan da za a cire ko izinin da za a duba. Kada ka rubuta kalmar sirri ta gaskiya, bayanan tuntuɓa ko takardun sirri.
cyber-privacy.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Riƙe bayanan sirri”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
cyber-privacy.statement: A saka kalmar sirri ta gaskiya cikin bayanan gwajin da ake rabawa.

cyber-updates.title: Sabunta na’ura cikin aminci
cyber-updates.body:
Yi ajiya, samo sabuntawa daga hukuma, sake kunnawa ka duba version.

Wasu matakai suna dogara da na baya. Bi kibiyoyin misalin ka bayyana abin da zai fara da dalilinsa. Shirya abin da za a yi idan mataki ya kasa. Duba kowane sauyi kafin ci gaba; kaiwa ƙarshe kaɗai ba ya nuna cewa duk aikin ya yi nasara.
cyber-updates.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Sabunta na’ura cikin aminci”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
cyber-updates.statement: Yi ajiya, samo sabuntawa daga hukuma, sake kunnawa ka duba version.
cyber-updates.code: backup → official update → restart → version check

cyber-network.title: Fahimci tafiyar hanyar sadarwa
cyber-network.body:
DNS yana gano address daga suna. HTTPS yana kare tafiyar data, amma shafin yaudara ma yana amfani da shi.

Tsari bayyananne yana ba kowane sashi aikinsa. Karanta misalin daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka gano abin shiga, muhimman filaye da sakamako. Nuna bayanin da babu shi maimakon ƙirƙirarsa. Alamomi masu daidaito suna sauƙaƙa dubawa da sake amfani da aikin.
cyber-network.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Fahimci tafiyar hanyar sadarwa”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
cyber-network.statement: Bayanin da babu shi dole ya zama sifili koyaushe.
cyber-network.code:
device → router → DNS → HTTPS server
// HTTPS protects transit; does not guarantee honesty

cyber-permissions.title: Zaɓi izini mafi ƙaranci
cyber-permissions.body:
Least privilege yana ba da izinin da aiki ke buƙata kawai; admin yana ƙara haɗari.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.

marketing-consent.body:
Nemi izini kafin tuntuɓar talla ka sauƙaƙa ficewa.

business-customer.title: Tambayi abokin ciniki mai yiwuwa

Tambayi halayen kwanan nan da matsaloli kafin gabatar da mafita.

writing-clarity.title: Sauƙaƙa jimloli

Cire maimaitawa ka raba dogayen jimloli ba tare da rasa ma’ana ba.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.

writing-evidence.title: Tallafa magana da hujja

Duba magana da tushen asali, kwanan wata da hujja.

Gwaji mai amfani yana bayyana abin shiga da sakamakon da ake tsammani kafin dubawa. Gwada misalin, sannan gwada babu bayanai ko abin da ba a zata ba. Rubuta abin da ya faru ka yi ƙaramin gyara. Sake gwadawa bayan gyara don tabbatar da warware matsalar.

project-risks.title: Tsara amsar haɗari
project-risks.body:
Rubuta yiwuwa, tasiri, mai alhaki da amsa ga haɗari; sake dubawa.

Haɗari yana haɗa yiwuwar faruwar abu da illarsa. Kwatanta yiwuwa da tasiri a misalin sannan zaɓi matakin kariya. Fara da manyan haɗari ka bayyana mai ɗaukar mataki. Jerin dubawa yana rage kuskure amma ba ya kawar da duk barazana.
project-risks.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Tsara amsar haɗari”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
project-risks.statement: Ƙarancin yiwuwa yana nufin haɗari ba zai taɓa cutarwa ba.

project-updates.title: Rubuta rahoton ci gaba
project-updates.body:
Rahoton ci gaba yana nuna kammalalle, na gaba, matsala da buƙata bayyananne.

Fara da mutumin da yake buƙatar aikin da abin da yake son yi. Misalin yana haɗa buƙata, amsa mai amfani da mataki na gaba. Ba da isasshen bayani, yi magana cikin mutunci kuma ka guji magana ba tare da hujja ba. Duba aikin tare da mutumin da aka yi masa.
project-updates.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Rubuta rahoton ci gaba”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
project-updates.statement: Rahoton ci gaba yana nuna kammalalle, na gaba, matsala da buƙata bayyananne.

project-retro.title: Yi bitar abin da ya faru
project-retro.body:
Duba abin da ya taimaka da ya hana; ba gyara guda mai aiki da kwanan wata.

Shawara mai amfani tana danganta da abin da aka gani kuma ta nuna mataki na gaba. Duba misalin don hujjar nasara da wahala. Raba abin da ka gani da abin da ka zato. Inganta abu guda ka duba tasirinsa; ƙaramin samfur ba ya wakiltar kowa.
project-retro.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Yi bitar abin da ya faru”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
project-retro.statement: Ƙaramin samfur yana tabbatar da buƙatar kowane mutum.

project-capstone.title: Tsara ka duba ƙaramin aiki
project-capstone.body:
Tsara iyaka, ayyuka, dogaro da haɗari ka duba sharadin karɓa na farko.

Haɗa ƙwarewar da ka koya a ƙaramin aiki. Yi amfani da misalin a matsayin tsari, saita buri mai amfani ka ƙirƙiri abin da za ka nuna. Gwada shi da burinka, bayyana iyaka guda da gyara guda. Riƙe rubutunka da hujja don wani ɗalibi ya fahimci shawararka.
project-capstone.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Tsara ka duba ƙaramin aiki”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
project-capstone.statement: Tsara iyaka, ayyuka, dogaro da haɗari ka duba sharadin karɓa na farko.
project-capstone.code: scope → tasks → dependencies → board → risk review → delivery check

teaching-goals.title: Rubuta burin koyo da ake iya gani
teaching-goals.body:
Yi amfani da aiki mai gani kamar bayyana ko lissafa maimakon fahimta kawai.

Tsari bayyananne yana ba kowane sashi aikinsa. Karanta misalin daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka gano abin shiga, muhimman filaye da sakamako. Nuna bayanin da babu shi maimakon ƙirƙirarsa. Alamomi masu daidaito suna sauƙaƙa dubawa da sake amfani da aikin.
teaching-goals.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Rubuta burin koyo da ake iya gani”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-goals.statement: Yi amfani da aiki mai gani kamar bayyana ko lissafa maimakon fahimta kawai.

teaching-baseline.title: Duba ilimin farko
teaching-baseline.body:
Gajeren aiki na farko yana nuna ilimin da aka sani da mataki na gaba.

Shawara mai amfani tana danganta da abin da aka gani kuma ta nuna mataki na gaba. Duba misalin don hujjar nasara da wahala. Raba abin da ka gani da abin da ka zato. Inganta abu guda ka duba tasirinsa; ƙaramin samfur ba ya wakiltar kowa.

teaching-example.title: Nuna misalin da aka warware
teaching-example.body:
Nuna matakai da dalili sannan tambayi ɗalibi ya hango mataki na gaba.

Wasu matakai suna dogara da na baya. Bi kibiyoyin misalin ka bayyana abin da zai fara da dalilinsa. Shirya abin da za a yi idan mataki ya kasa. Duba kowane sauyi kafin ci gaba; kaiwa ƙarshe kaɗai ba ya nuna cewa duk aikin ya yi nasara.
teaching-example.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Nuna misalin da aka warware”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-example.statement: Nuna matakai da dalili sannan tambayi ɗalibi ya hango mataki na gaba.

teaching-practice.title: Tsara gwaji tare da jagora
teaching-practice.body:
Fara da jagora ka rage alamomi kafin aikin kai.

Wasu matakai suna dogara da na baya. Bi kibiyoyin misalin ka bayyana abin da zai fara da dalilinsa. Shirya abin da za a yi idan mataki ya kasa. Duba kowane sauyi kafin ci gaba; kaiwa ƙarshe kaɗai ba ya nuna cewa duk aikin ya yi nasara.
teaching-practice.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Tsara gwaji tare da jagora”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-practice.statement: Matakin dogaro yana iya farawa kafin na farko koyaushe.

teaching-feedback.title: Ba da shawarar da za a yi amfani da ita
teaching-feedback.body:
Bayyana abin da ka gani da gyara na gaba sannan ba da damar sake gwadawa.

Shawara mai amfani tana danganta da abin da aka gani kuma ta nuna mataki na gaba. Duba misalin don hujjar nasara da wahala. Raba abin da ka gani da abin da ka zato. Inganta abu guda ka duba tasirinsa; ƙaramin samfur ba ya wakiltar kowa.
teaching-feedback.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Ba da shawarar da za a yi amfani da ita”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-feedback.statement: Bayyana abin da ka gani da gyara na gaba sannan ba da damar sake gwadawa.

teaching-check.title: Duba ƙwarewa da sabon misali
teaching-check.body:
Duba ƙwarewa ɗaya da sabon misali domin haddacewa kaɗai ba ta isa ba.

Gwaji mai amfani yana bayyana abin shiga da sakamakon da ake tsammani kafin dubawa. Gwada misalin, sannan gwada babu bayanai ko abin da ba a zata ba. Rubuta abin da ya faru ka yi ƙaramin gyara. Sake gwadawa bayan gyara don tabbatar da warware matsalar.
teaching-check.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Duba ƙwarewa da sabon misali”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-check.statement: Gwajin nasara guda yana tabbatar da aiki a kowane yanayi.

teaching-inclusive.title: Sauƙaƙa gwaji ga kowa
teaching-inclusive.body:
Ba da rubutu mai karantawa, zane da sauƙin amfani tare da buri ɗaya.

Kwatanta zaɓuɓɓuka bisa buri bayyananne, ba kyawunsu kawai ba. Misalin yana nuna zaɓuɓɓuka ko iyaka. Bayyana abin da ake samu da abin da ake rasa; yi kwatanci na adalci da hujja. Abin da ya yi aiki a wuri ɗaya na iya buƙatar gyara a wani.
teaching-inclusive.practice: Yi nazarin misalin sannan ƙirƙiri naka na “Sauƙaƙa gwaji ga kowa”. Canza bayanin shiga ko shawara guda, bayyana sakamako da yadda tsarinka ya cika buri.
teaching-inclusive.statement: Ba da rubutu mai karantawa, zane da sauƙin amfani tare da buri ɗaya.

teaching-plan.body:

Wasu matakai suna dogara da na baya. Bi kibiyoyin misalin ka bayyana abin da zai fara da dalilinsa. Shirya abin da za a yi idan mataki ya kasa. Duba kowane sauyi kafin ci gaba; kaiwa ƙarshe kaɗai ba ya nuna cewa duk aikin ya yi nasara.
